package smb

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"syscall"
	"testing"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/authz"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb/internal/signing"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb/internal/wire"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/storage"
)

func gateNoLeaseRequest(t *testing.T, name string, level byte, inner []byte) wire.Request {
	t.Helper()
	r := createCommand(name, 1, 1)
	r.Body[3] = level
	if inner != nil {
		return requestContexts(t, r, []wire.CreateContext{{Name: []byte("RqLs"), Data: inner}})
	}
	return r
}
func gateNoLeaseContext(t *testing.T, version uint16) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := wire.LeaseResponseData(wire.LeaseResponse{Version: version, Key: [16]byte{17}, Epoch: 19})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	smbLE.PutUint32(data[16:], 7)
	return data
}
func gateNoLeaseID(t *testing.T, p []byte) wire.FileID {
	t.Helper()
	h, err := wire.ParseHeader(p)
	if err != nil || h.Status != 0 || len(p) < 152 || p[66] != 0 || smbLE.Uint32(p[144:]) != 0 || smbLE.Uint32(p[148:]) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("CREATE must return NONE without contexts: %+v %v %x", h, err, p)
	}
	var id wire.FileID
	copy(id[:], p[128:144])
	return id
}
func gateNoLeaseClose(id wire.FileID) wire.Request {
	b := make([]byte, 24)
	smbLE.PutUint16(b, 24)
	copy(b[8:], id[:])
	return fileRequest(wire.Close, b)
}

type gateNoLeasePeer struct {
	server  *Server
	network net.Conn
	sid     uint64
	tree    uint32
	key     *signing.Session
	next    uint64
}

func (p *gateNoLeasePeer) call(t *testing.T, r wire.Request) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	h := wire.Header{Command: r.Header.Command, MessageID: p.next, SessionID: p.sid, TreeID: p.tree, Credits: 1}
	p.next++
	packet := requestPacket(h, r.Body)
	if err := p.key.Sign(packet); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sendFrame(t, p.network, packet)
	reply := readFrame(t, p.network)
	rh, err := wire.ParseHeader(reply)
	if err != nil || rh.Command != h.Command || rh.MessageID != h.MessageID || p.key.Verify(reply) != nil {
		t.Fatalf("signed response %+v %v", rh, err)
	}
	return reply
}
func gateNoLeaseConnect(t *testing.T, open func(windowsOpenRequest) (windowsOpenResult, error)) (*gateNoLeasePeer, *backendSession) {
	return gateNoLeaseConnectWithAuthorizer(t, open, testConfig().Authorize)
}
func gateNoLeaseConnectWithAuthorizer(t *testing.T, open func(windowsOpenRequest) (windowsOpenResult, error), authorizer authz.Authorizer) (*gateNoLeasePeer, *backendSession) {
	t.Helper()
	config := testConfig()
	config.Authorize = authorizer
	server, network := startConfiguredServer(t, config)
	backend := &backendSession{commandSession: &commandSession{open: open}}
	_, err := server.publish(Share{Name: "work", Volume: "trusted", Changes: testNotifySource(testNotifyStream())}, &sessionBackend{session: backend})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sid, key := authenticateProtocol(t, network)
	peer := &gateNoLeasePeer{server: server, network: network, sid: sid, key: key, next: 3}
	name := wire.EncodeUTF16("\\\\127.0.0.1\\work")
	body := make([]byte, 8+len(name))
	smbLE.PutUint16(body, 9)
	smbLE.PutUint16(body[4:], 72)
	smbLE.PutUint16(body[6:], uint16(len(name)))
	copy(body[8:], name)
	response := peer.call(t, fileRequest(wire.TreeConnect, body))
	header, _ := wire.ParseHeader(response)
	if header.Status != 0 {
		t.Fatal(header)
	}
	peer.tree = header.TreeID
	if server.leases != nil {
		t.Fatal("unsupported leasing allocated a lease table")
	}
	server.mu.Lock()
	var connections []*connection
	for c := range server.connections {
		connections = append(connections, c)
	}
	server.mu.Unlock()
	for _, c := range connections {
		c.mu.Lock()
		s := c.sessions[sid]
		c.mu.Unlock()
		if s != nil {
			s.mu.Lock()
			tree := s.trees[peer.tree]
			if tree == nil || tree.files.leases != nil {
				s.mu.Unlock()
				t.Fatal("unsupported leasing allocated a tree lease owner")
			}
			s.mu.Unlock()
		}
	}
	return peer, backend
}

func TestGateNoLeasingNegotiationAndSigning(t *testing.T) {
	for _, bootstrap := range []bool{false, true} {
		t.Run(map[bool]string{false: "direct", true: "bootstrap"}[bootstrap], func(t *testing.T) {
			server, c := startProtocolServer(t)
			if server.leases != nil {
				t.Fatal("lease table allocated")
			}
			if bootstrap {
				sendFrame(t, c, multiProtocolPacket())
				p := readFrame(t, c)
				if smbLE.Uint32(p[88:]) != 4 || smbLE.Uint16(p[68:]) != wire.DialectWildcard || smbLE.Uint16(p[66:]) != 3 {
					t.Fatalf("wildcard caps/signing %x", p)
				}
				sid, key := authenticateProtocolAt(t, c, 1)
				packet := requestPacket(wire.Header{Command: wire.Echo, MessageID: 4, SessionID: sid, Credits: 1}, wire.EmptyResponseBody())
				if err := key.Sign(packet); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				sendFrame(t, c, packet)
				reply := readFrame(t, c)
				h, _ := wire.ParseHeader(reply)
				if h.Status != 0 || key.Verify(reply) != nil {
					t.Fatal(h)
				}
			} else {
				sendFrame(t, c, negotiatePacket())
				p := readFrame(t, c)
				if smbLE.Uint32(p[88:]) != 4 || smbLE.Uint16(p[68:]) != wire.Dialect311 || smbLE.Uint16(p[66:]) != 3 {
					t.Fatalf("formal caps/signing %x", p)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGateNoLeasingIgnoresOnlyInnerLeaseContext(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name  string
		level byte
		inner []byte
	}{{"v1", wire.OplockLease, gateNoLeaseContext(t, wire.LeaseVersion1)}, {"v2", wire.OplockLease, gateNoLeaseContext(t, wire.LeaseVersion2)}, {"short inner", wire.OplockLease, []byte{1, 2, 3}}, {"missing context", wire.OplockLease, nil}, {"batch", 9, nil}}
	bad := gateNoLeaseContext(t, wire.LeaseVersion2)
	smbLE.PutUint32(bad[16:], 0xffffffff)
	cases = append(cases, struct {
		name  string
		level byte
		inner []byte
	}{"invalid inner state", wire.OplockLease, bad})
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			calls := 0
			d, file, session, _ := commandDispatcher()
			d.handles = make(map[wire.FileID]*fileHandle)
			session.open = func(r windowsOpenRequest) (windowsOpenResult, error) {
				calls++
				if r.Lookup.Name == "" {
					root := &commandFile{attr: windowsAttr{windowsBasicAttr: windowsBasicAttr{Attr: storage.Attr{ID: 1, Kind: storage.NodeDirectory}}}}
					return windowsOpenResult{File: root, Attr: root.attr}, nil
				}
				if r.Lookup.ExpectedID != 0 {
					t.Fatal("lease preflight pinned stale object")
				}
				return windowsOpenResult{File: file, Attr: file.attr, CreateAction: windowsOpened}, nil
			}
			body, status := d.create(t.Context(), gateNoLeaseRequest(t, "file", tc.level, tc.inner))
			if status != 0 || len(body) < 88 || body[2] != 0 || smbLE.Uint32(body[80:]) != 0 || smbLE.Uint32(body[84:]) != 0 || calls != 2 || d.leases != nil {
				t.Fatalf("status=%x calls=%d body=%x", status, calls, body)
			}
			var id wire.FileID
			copy(id[:], body[64:80])
			if _, status = d.closeOrFlush(t.Context(), gateNoLeaseClose(id)); status != 0 {
				t.Fatal(status)
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestGateNoLeasingKeepsOuterBounds(t *testing.T) {
	d, _, session, _ := commandDispatcher()
	calls := 0
	session.open = func(windowsOpenRequest) (windowsOpenResult, error) { calls++; return windowsOpenResult{}, nil }
	request := gateNoLeaseRequest(t, "file", wire.OplockLease, []byte{1, 2, 3})
	smbLE.PutUint32(request.Body[48:], 0xfffffff0)
	if _, status := d.create(t.Context(), request); status != fileInvalidParameter || calls != 0 {
		t.Fatal(status, calls)
	}
}

func TestGateNoLeasingReplacementKeepsSeparateOpenIdentities(t *testing.T) {
	a := &commandFile{attr: windowsAttr{windowsBasicAttr: windowsBasicAttr{Attr: storage.Attr{ID: 7, Kind: storage.NodeRegular, Size: 3}}}, data: []byte("AAA")}
	b := &commandFile{attr: windowsAttr{windowsBasicAttr: windowsBasicAttr{Attr: storage.Attr{ID: 8, Kind: storage.NodeRegular, Size: 5}}}, data: []byte("BBBBB")}
	var mu sync.Mutex
	current := a
	leafCalls := 0
	peer, _ := gateNoLeaseConnect(t, func(r windowsOpenRequest) (windowsOpenResult, error) {
		if r.Lookup.Name == "" {
			root := &commandFile{attr: windowsAttr{windowsBasicAttr: windowsBasicAttr{Attr: storage.Attr{ID: 1, Kind: storage.NodeDirectory}}}}
			return windowsOpenResult{File: root, Attr: root.attr}, nil
		}
		mu.Lock()
		defer mu.Unlock()
		leafCalls++
		if r.Lookup.ExpectedID != 0 {
			t.Fatal("lease-key object preflight still active")
		}
		if current == nil {
			return windowsOpenResult{}, &verifiedMissingNameError{}
		}
		return windowsOpenResult{File: current, Attr: current.attr, CreateAction: windowsOpened}, nil
	})
	request := gateNoLeaseRequest(t, "target.bin", wire.OplockLease, gateNoLeaseContext(t, wire.LeaseVersion2))
	oldID := gateNoLeaseID(t, peer.call(t, request))
	mu.Lock()
	current = b
	mu.Unlock()
	newID := gateNoLeaseID(t, peer.call(t, request))
	if oldID == newID {
		t.Fatal("different opens reused SMB FileID")
	}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		id   wire.FileID
		node uint64
		data string
	}{{oldID, 7, "AAA"}, {newID, 8, "BBBBB"}} {
		reply := peer.call(t, readCommand(test.id, 0, 32))
		header, _ := wire.ParseHeader(reply)
		if header.Status != 0 || string(reply[80:]) != test.data {
			t.Fatalf("read %+v %q", header, reply[80:])
		}
		reply = peer.call(t, queryCommand(test.id, 1, 6, 64))
		header, _ = wire.ParseHeader(reply)
		if header.Status != 0 || smbLE.Uint64(reply[72:]) != test.node {
			t.Fatalf("identity %+v %x", header, reply)
		}
	}
	mu.Lock()
	current = nil
	mu.Unlock()
	reply := peer.call(t, request)
	header, _ := wire.ParseHeader(reply)
	if header.Status != 0xc000000f {
		t.Fatalf("final missing mapping was bypassed: %x", header.Status)
	}
	c := &commandFile{attr: windowsAttr{windowsBasicAttr: windowsBasicAttr{Attr: storage.Attr{ID: 9, Kind: storage.NodeRegular, Size: 2}}}, data: []byte("CC")}
	mu.Lock()
	current = c
	mu.Unlock()
	recreated := gateNoLeaseID(t, peer.call(t, request))
	reply = peer.call(t, queryCommand(recreated, 1, 6, 64))
	if smbLE.Uint64(reply[72:]) != 9 {
		t.Fatal("recreated name retained old node identity")
	}
	reply = peer.call(t, readCommand(oldID, 0, 32))
	if string(reply[80:]) != "AAA" {
		t.Fatal("old handle was rebound after recreation")
	}
	for _, id := range []wire.FileID{oldID, newID, recreated} {
		reply = peer.call(t, gateNoLeaseClose(id))
		header, _ = wire.ParseHeader(reply)
		if header.Status != 0 {
			t.Fatal(header)
		}
	}
	mu.Lock()
	count := leafCalls
	mu.Unlock()
	if count != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected lease-only preflight calls: %d", count)
	}
	reply = peer.call(t, fileRequest(wire.TreeDisconnect, wire.EmptyResponseBody()))
	header, _ = wire.ParseHeader(reply)
	if header.Status != 0 {
		t.Fatal(header)
	}
	reply = peer.call(t, fileRequest(wire.Logoff, wire.EmptyResponseBody()))
	header, _ = wire.ParseHeader(reply)
	if header.Status != 0 {
		t.Fatal(header)
	}
	status := peer.server.Status()
	if status.LeaseSlots != 0 || status.LeaseBytes != 0 || status.UnconfirmedMutations != 0 {
		t.Fatal(status)
	}
}

func TestGateNoLeasingPreservesOpenFailuresAndReconciliation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, unknown := range []bool{false, true} {
		t.Run(map[bool]string{false: "share denial", true: "unknown result"}[unknown], func(t *testing.T) {
			d, file, session, _ := commandDispatcher()
			d.handles = make(map[wire.FileID]*fileHandle)
			session.open = func(r windowsOpenRequest) (windowsOpenResult, error) {
				if r.Lookup.Name == "" {
					root := &commandFile{attr: windowsAttr{windowsBasicAttr: windowsBasicAttr{Attr: storage.Attr{ID: 1, Kind: storage.NodeDirectory}}}}
					return windowsOpenResult{File: root, Attr: root.attr}, nil
				}
				if unknown {
					return windowsOpenResult{}, syscall.EIO
				}
				return windowsOpenResult{}, &windowsError{Failure: windowsSharingViolation, Err: syscall.EACCES}
			}
			session.result = windowsActionResult{State: windowsActionCompleted, File: file, Attr: file.attr, CreateAction: windowsOpened, GrantedAccess: windowsReadData}
			body, status := d.create(t.Context(), gateNoLeaseRequest(t, "file", wire.OplockLease, gateNoLeaseContext(t, wire.LeaseVersion2)))
			if unknown {
				if status != 0 || body[2] != 0 || d.failed || len(d.handles) != 1 {
					t.Fatal(status, d.failed)
				}
				var id wire.FileID
				copy(id[:], body[64:80])
				if _, status = d.closeOrFlush(t.Context(), gateNoLeaseClose(id)); status != 0 {
					t.Fatal(status)
				}
			} else if status != 0xc0000043 || len(d.handles) != 0 {
				t.Fatal(status, len(d.handles))
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestGateNoLeasingRetainsAuthorizationAndRejectsUnsolicitedAck(t *testing.T) {
	file := &commandFile{attr: windowsAttr{windowsBasicAttr: windowsBasicAttr{Attr: storage.Attr{ID: 7, Kind: storage.NodeRegular, Size: 3}}}, data: []byte("abc")}
	var deny atomic.Bool
	policy := authz.AuthorizerFunc(func(ctx context.Context, r authz.AccessRequest) error {
		p, ok := PrincipalFromContext(ctx)
		if !ok || p.SID != "S-1-5-21-1" || r.Volume != "trusted" {
			return errors.New("identity/volume binding changed")
		}
		if deny.Load() {
			return authz.ErrDenied
		}
		return nil
	})
	peer, _ := gateNoLeaseConnectWithAuthorizer(t, func(r windowsOpenRequest) (windowsOpenResult, error) {
		if r.Lookup.Name == "" {
			root := &commandFile{attr: windowsAttr{windowsBasicAttr: windowsBasicAttr{Attr: storage.Attr{ID: 1, Kind: storage.NodeDirectory}}}}
			return windowsOpenResult{File: root, Attr: root.attr}, nil
		}
		return windowsOpenResult{File: file, Attr: file.attr, CreateAction: windowsOpened}, nil
	}, policy)
	id := gateNoLeaseID(t, peer.call(t, gateNoLeaseRequest(t, "file", wire.OplockLease, gateNoLeaseContext(t, wire.LeaseVersion2))))
	deny.Store(true)
	reply := peer.call(t, readCommand(id, 0, 1))
	header, _ := wire.ParseHeader(reply)
	if header.Status != statusDenied {
		t.Fatal(header)
	}
	deny.Store(false)
	ack := make([]byte, 36)
	smbLE.PutUint16(ack, 36)
	reply = peer.call(t, fileRequest(wire.OplockBreak, ack))
	header, _ = wire.ParseHeader(reply)
	if header.Status != statusUnsupported {
		t.Fatal(header)
	}
	tree := peer.tree
	peer.tree = 999
	reply = peer.call(t, fileRequest(wire.OplockBreak, ack))
	header, _ = wire.ParseHeader(reply)
	if header.Status != statusNetworkDeleted {
		t.Fatal(header)
	}
	peer.tree = tree
	unsigned := readCommand(id, 0, 1)
	packet := requestPacket(wire.Header{Command: wire.Read, MessageID: peer.next, SessionID: peer.sid, TreeID: peer.tree, Credits: 1}, unsigned.Body)
	peer.next++
	sendFrame(t, peer.network, packet)
	reply = readFrame(t, peer.network)
	header, _ = wire.ParseHeader(reply)
	if header.Status != statusDenied {
		t.Fatal("unsigned read accepted", header)
	}
	reply = peer.call(t, gateNoLeaseClose(id))
	header, _ = wire.ParseHeader(reply)
	if header.Status != 0 {
		t.Fatal(header)
	}
}
func TestGateNoLeasingIdleLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	s, err := New(testConfig())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if s.leases != nil {
		t.Fatal("lease table allocated")
	}
	if err = s.Shutdown(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if s.Status().LeaseSlots != 0 || s.Status().LeaseBytes != 0 || !s.Status().Stopped {
		t.Fatal(s.Status())
	}
	if err = s.Shutdown(t.Context()); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, ErrStopped) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
